messages:
aj_support: Escalating SolsticeRx onboarding — provisioning failing (403) when we hit the embed endpoint, trial ends in 9 days. Customer is asking for a working demo, billing contact unresponsive. Marking P1 to CS. :exclamation:

maria_cs: Thanks, AJ. Can you drop the exact error and the request id? Also is this in hosted or dedicated?

aj_support: Hosted. Error verbatim: "403 Forbidden - key missing or invalid". Request ID: req_7b9c2f. Tried rotating the test key and repro'd on our side. Repro steps pasted below.

aj_support: ```bash
curl -X POST 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer test_XXXX" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings 
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```

maria_cs: Got it. Two immediate asks: 1) Can Eng confirm whether the key rotation path is having a propagation bug? 2) We need a comms plan for SolsticeRx — high-touch, offer 14-day trial extension + dedicated onboarding session if we can't fix in 24h. Tagging @nora_aesales for contract/renewal check. :eyes: 

nora_aesales: On it. If we extend trial, please capture the exact dates and include a one-paragraph customer-facing note I can send. Also need to escalate renewal signal — this customer is in a target segment.

maria_cs: Proposed comms (short):
- 0h: Acknowledge and offer temporary workaround (use UI token + manual ingest) + commit to ETA.
- 12h: Status update with root cause / workaround steps.
- 24h: If not resolved, schedule a live debugging session and offer 14-day extension + free onboarding hour.
Please confirm owners.

kevin_engineering: I can take the debug. I'll start by checking the key propagation job and the auth microservice logs for req_7b9c2f. If it's a recent deploy, I can roll back a tiny patch. ETA first pass in 2h.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0319-451 — Auth service 403 spike affecting onboarding flows. Pager duty alerted.

maria_cs: Owners: Eng (Kevin) — root cause/debug. CS (Maria) — comms & trial extension copy. AE (Nora) — renewal signal + contract. Support (AJ) — customer-facing triage notes + workaround.

aj_support: Customer workaround: asked them to generate a UI API token and post test file via UI route — they confirmed it succeeds. Sent that note to customer and told them we'll follow up within 2 hours.

maria_cs: Nora, draft for AE to send: 
"Hi Team SolsticeRx — we see a provisioning auth issue affecting your trial demo. We recommend a short workaround to continue testing (details below). Our engineering team is actively investigating and we will provide a status update within 12 hours. If we can’t fully resolve within 24 hours we’ll extend your trial by 14 days and set up a dedicated onboarding session."

nora_aesales: Draft looks good, sending now. Copying legal for the extension terms.

kevin_engineering: Quick update: found a regression in the key cache invalidation during the last deploy — keys rotated within 60s window could be rejected if requests land in a specific pod. I’ve pushed a fix to canary and the auth cache TTL bump. Monitoring now.

maria_cs: Perfect. Once KPIs look stable for 30m, send the customer update that auth fix is deployed and they should try again. If any flake remains, proceed with the comms plan.

aj_support: Will confirm with customer once kevin says green. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
